# Threads.net Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/threads-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/threads-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects Threads.net post and profile data, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to scrape Threads by Meta using Python (2025 Update)](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-threads)
- **Code:** [`threads.py`](threads.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Profile pages](results/profile.json) · [Thread pages](results/thread.json)

## What it scrapes

- Threads.net Thread (aka post) data
- Threads.net Profile data

## Functions

- `scrape_thread(url)` → `Dict`: Scrape a single thread page: https://www.threads.net/t/CuVdfsNtmvh/ Return parent thread and reply threads
- `scrape_profile(url)` → `Dict`: Scrapes Twitter user profile page e.g.: https://www.threads.net/@zuck returns user data and latest tweets

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import threads


async def main():
    thread = await threads.scrape_thread("https://www.threads.net/t/C8CTu0iswgv")
    profile = await threads.scrape_profile("https://www.threads.net/@natgeo")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields of the sample output (top-level keys of the first item):

- [`results/profile.json`](results/profile.json): `user`, `threads`
- [`results/thread.json`](results/thread.json): `thread`, `replies`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`threads.py`](threads.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy

## Notes

Note: This scraper is only scraping public Threads data that doesn't require a login to access.

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/threads-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_thread_scraping`, `test_user_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
